<!DOCTYPE html> <html lang="gu"> <head> <meta charset="UTF-8"> <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"> <title>GSSSB CCE 2026 - Official CBT Mock Test Platform</title> <style> :root { --primary: #1976d2; } /* Views Container */ .view-section { display: none; min-height: calc(100vh - 65px); } .view-section.active { display: block; } /* HUB / SHIFTS DIRECTORY */ .hub-container { max-width: 1280px; margin: 20px auto; } // Finalize Submit function finalizeSubmitTest(isAutoSubmit = false) { closeSubmitModal(); clearInterval(timerInterval); if (!currentShift) return; let correctCount = 0; let wrongCount = 0; let unattemptedCount = 0; const sectionBreakdown = SECTIONS_CONFIG.map(sec => ({ name: sec.name, total: sec.count, attempted: 0, correct: 0, wrong: 0, marks: 0, accuracy: 0 })); currentShift.questions.forEach((q, idx) => { const qNum = idx + 1; const userChoice = testAnswers[qNum]; const correctChoice = q.ans; const secIdx = SECTIONS_CONFIG.findIndex(s => qNum >= s.start && qNum <= s.end); if (userChoice !== undefined) { sectionBreakdown[secIdx].attempted++; if (userChoice === correctChoice) { correctCount++; sectionBreakdown[secIdx].correct++; } else { wrongCount++; sectionBreakdown[secIdx].wrong++; } } else { unattemptedCount++; } }); const totalScore = Math.max(0, (correctCount * 1.0) - (wrongCount * 0.25)); const accuracy = (correctCount + wrongCount) > 0 ? (correctCount / (correctCount + wrongCount)) * 100 : 0; sectionBreakdown.forEach(sec => { sec.marks = (sec.correct * 1.0) - (sec.wrong * 0.25); sec.accuracy = sec.attempted > 0 ? (sec.correct / sec.attempted) * 100 : 0; }); const resultRecord = { shiftId: currentShift.id, shiftName: currentShift.name, date: currentShift.date, timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString('gu-IN'), score: totalScore, correctCount, wrongCount, unattemptedCount, accuracy, answers: testAnswers, sectionBreakdown }; const history = getStoredHistory(); history[currentShift.id] = resultRecord; saveStoredHistory(history); clearActiveSession(); displayResult(resultRecord); showResultView(); } function viewShiftResult(shiftId) { const history = getStoredHistory(); const rec = history[shiftId]; if (!rec) return; currentShift = ALL_SHIFTS_DATA.find(s => s.id === shiftId); displayResult(rec); showResultView(); } function reattemptCurrentShift() { if (!currentShift) return; launchTest(currentShift); } function displayResult(rec) { document.getElementById('res-shift-name').innerText = rec.shiftName; document.getElementById('res-timestamp').innerText = `અટેમ્પ કરેલ: ${rec.timestamp}`; document.getElementById('res-score-val').innerText = rec.score.toFixed(2); document.getElementById('res-accuracy-val').innerText = `${rec.accuracy.toFixed(1)}%`; document.getElementById('res-correct-val').innerText = rec.correctCount; document.getElementById('res-wrong-val').innerText = rec.wrongCount; document.getElementById('res-skipped-val').innerText = rec.unattemptedCount; const tbody = document.getElementById('res-breakdown-tbody'); tbody.innerHTML = rec.sectionBreakdown.map(sec => ` <tr> <td><strong>${sec.name}</strong></td> <td>${sec.total}</td> <td>${sec.attempted}</td> <td style="color: var(--success); font-weight: 700;">${sec.correct}</td> <td style="color: var(--danger); font-weight: 700;">${sec.wrong}</td> <td style="font-weight: 700;">${sec.marks.toFixed(2)}</td> <td>${sec.accuracy.toFixed(1)}%</td> </tr> `).join(''); renderReviewQuestions(rec, 'all'); } let currentReviewFilter = 'all'; function filterReviewQuestions(filterType) { currentReviewFilter = filterType; document.querySelectorAll('.review-filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); event.target.classList.add('active'); const history = getStoredHistory(); if (currentShift && history[currentShift.id]) { renderReviewQuestions(history[currentShift.id], filterType); } } function renderReviewQuestions(rec, filterType) { const container = document.getElementById('review-questions-list'); if (!currentShift) return; const items = []; currentShift.questions.forEach((q, idx) => { const qNum = idx + 1; const userChoice = rec.answers[qNum]; const correctChoice = q.ans; const isAttempted = userChoice !== undefined; const isCorrect = isAttempted && (userChoice === correctChoice); const isWrong = isAttempted && (userChoice !== correctChoice); if (filterType === 'correct' && !isCorrect) return; if (filterType === 'wrong' && !isWrong) return; if (filterType === 'skipped' && isAttempted) return; let statusBadge = isCorrect ? '<span class="solution-status-tag correct">✓ સાચો (+1.00)</span>' : (isWrong ? '<span class="solution-status-tag wrong">✗ ખોટો (-0.25)</span>' : '<span class="solution-status-tag skipped">○ બાકી (0.00)</span>'); const optionsHtml = q.opts.map((optText, optIdx) => { const optNum = optIdx + 1; const isOfficial = optNum === correctChoice; const isUserPick = optNum === userChoice; let optClass = isOfficial ? 'is-correct-answer' : (isUserPick ? 'is-user-wrong' : ''); let badges = isOfficial ? '<span class="sol-opt-badge official">સાચો જવાબ</span>' : ''; if (isUserPick && !isOfficial) badges += '<span class="sol-opt-badge your-choice">તમારો જવાબ</span>'; return ` <div class="sol-option ${optClass}"> <span><strong>(${optNum})</strong> ${escapeHtml(optText)}</span> ${badges} </div> `; }).join(''); items.push(` <div class="solution-item"> <div class="solution-item-header"> <span style="font-weight: 700;">Question No. ${qNum} · ${q.sec}</span> ${statusBadge} </div> <div class="sol-q-text">${escapeHtml(q.q)}</div> <div class="sol-options-grid">${optionsHtml}</div> </div> `); }); container.innerHTML = items.length > 0 ? items.join('') : '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--text-muted);">કોઈ પ્રશ્ન મળ્યા નથી.</div>'; } // Analytics Dashboard function renderAnalytics() { const history = getStoredHistory(); const attempts = Object.values(history); const totalAttempts = attempts.length; document.getElementById('cum-total-attempts').innerText = `${totalAttempts} / 40`; if (totalAttempts === 0) { document.getElementById('cum-avg-score').innerText = '0.00'; document.getElementById('cum-high-score').innerText = '0.00'; document.getElementById('cum-total-solved').innerText = '0'; document.getElementById('analytics-subjects-bars').innerHTML = '<div style="color: var(--text-muted); padding: 10px;">હજુ સુધી કોઈ શિફ્ટ અટેમ્પ કરેલ નથી. એક શિફ્ટ અટેમ્પ કરીને શરૂ કરો!</div>'; document.getElementById('cum-history-tbody').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted);">કોઈ રેકોર્ડ નથી.</td></tr>'; return; } const scores = attempts.map(a => a.score); const avgScore = scores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / totalAttempts; const highScore = Math.max(...scores); const totalSolved = attempts.reduce((a, b) => a + (150 - b.unattemptedCount), 0); document.getElementById('cum-avg-score').innerText = avgScore.toFixed(2); document.getElementById('cum-high-score').innerText = highScore.toFixed(2); document.getElementById('cum-total-solved').innerText = totalSolved; // Section Subject Mastery const secStats = {}; SECTIONS_CONFIG.forEach(sec => { secStats[sec.name] = { correct: 0, total: 0 }; }); attempts.forEach(att => { att.sectionBreakdown.forEach(s => { secStats[s.name].correct += s.correct; secStats[s.name].total += s.total; }); }); const barsHtml = SECTIONS_CONFIG.map(sec => { const st = secStats[sec.name]; const pct = st.total > 0 ? (st.correct / st.total) * 100 : 0; return ` <div> <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px;"> <span>${sec.name}</span> <span>${pct.toFixed(1)}% (${st.correct}/${st.total})</span> </div> <div style="background: var(--border); height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;"> <div style="background: var(--primary); width: ${pct}%; height: 100%;"></div> </div> </div> `; }).join(''); document.getElementById('analytics-subjects-bars').innerHTML = barsHtml; // Attempt History Table const rowsHtml = attempts.map(att => ` <tr> <td><strong>${att.shiftName}</strong></td> <td>${att.timestamp}</td> <td style="font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary);">${att.score.toFixed(2)}</td> <td>${att.accuracy.toFixed(1)}%</td> <td>${att.correctCount} / ${att.wrongCount}</td> <td> <button class="nav-tab-btn" style="background: var(--primary); color: white; padding: 4px 8px;" onclick="viewShiftResult('${att.shiftId}')">રિવ્યુ</button> </td> </tr> `).join(''); document.getElementById('cum-history-tbody').innerHTML = rowsHtml; } // Bookmarks View function renderBookmarks() { const container = document.getElementById('bookmarks-list-container'); const bookmarks = getBookmarks(); const list = Object.values(bookmarks); if (list.length === 0) { container.innerHTML = '<div class="shift-card" style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);">કોઈ પ્રશ્ન બુકમાર્ક કરેલ નથી. ટેસ્ટ દરમિયાન પ્રશ્નની બાજુમાં આપેલ સ્ટાર (☆) પર ક્લિક કરીને પ્રશ્ન અહીં સેવ કરી શકો છો.</div>'; return; } container.innerHTML = list.map(item => ` <div class="solution-item"> <div class="solution-item-header"> <span style="font-weight: 700;">${item.shiftName} · Q.${item.qNum} (${item.question.sec})</span> <span class="sol-opt-badge official">સાચો જવાબ: Option ${item.question.ans}</span> </div> <div class="sol-q-text">${escapeHtml(item.question.q)}</div> <div class="sol-options-grid"> ${item.question.opts.map((opt, i) => ` <div class="sol-option ${i + 1 === item.question.ans ? 'is-correct-answer' : ''}"> <span><strong>(${i + 1})</strong> ${escapeHtml(opt)}</span> ${i + 1 === item.question.ans ? '<span class="sol-opt-badge official">સાચો જવાબ</span>' : ''} </div> `).join('')} </div> </div> `).join(''); } // Utility Tools: Dark Mode, Full Screen, Calculator, Scratchpad function toggleDarkMode() { document.body.classList.toggle('dark-mode'); localStorage.setItem('CCE_DARK_MODE', document.body.classList.contains('dark-mode')); } function toggleFullScreen() { if (!document.fullscreenElement) document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {}); else document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {}); } function adjustFontSize(dir) { let cur = parseInt(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--q-font-size')) || 16; if (dir === 0) cur = 16; else cur = Math.max(13, Math.min(22, cur + dir * 2)); document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--q-font-size', `${cur}px`); } // Virtual Calculator Logic let calcVal = '0'; function toggleVirtualCalculator() { const el = document.getElementById('calc-modal'); el.style.display = el.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block'; } function calcInput(char) { const scr = document.getElementById('calc-screen'); if (char === 'C') calcVal = '0'; else if (char === '=') { try { calcVal = String(eval(calcVal)); } catch (e) { calcVal = 'Error'; } } else { calcVal = calcVal === '0' ? char : calcVal + char; } scr.innerText = calcVal; } // Scratchpad Logic function toggleScratchpad() { const el = document.getElementById('scratchpad-modal'); el.style.display = el.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block'; document.getElementById('scratchpad-text').value = localStorage.getItem('CCE_SCRATCHPAD') || ''; } function saveScratchpad() { localStorage.setItem('CCE_SCRATCHPAD', document.getElementById('scratchpad-text').value); } // Export Data Backup function exportDataBackup() { const data = { history: getStoredHistory(), bookmarks: getBookmarks(), scratchpad: localStorage.getItem('CCE_SCRATCHPAD') || '' }; const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = `GSSSB_CCE_Mock_Backup_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`; a.click(); } // Keyboard Shortcuts (1-4 for options) window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (!currentShift || document.getElementById('view-cbt').classList.contains('active') === false) return; if (['1', '2', '3', '4'].includes(e.key)) selectOption(parseInt(e.key)); else if (e.key === 'Enter') saveAndNext(); }); // Check for Dark Mode & Active Session on Load window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { if (localStorage.getItem('CCE_DARK_MODE') === 'true') document.body.classList.add('dark-mode'); const activeSession = getActiveSession(); if (activeSession && activeSession.shiftId) { const shift = ALL_SHIFTS_DATA.find(s => s.id === activeSession.shiftId); if (shift && confirm(`તમે '${shift.name}' ટેસ્ટ આપી રહ્યા હતા. શું તમે ત્યાંથી આગળ ચાલુ રાખવા માંગો છો?`)) { launchTest(shift, activeSession); return; } else { clearActiveSession(); } } showHubView(); }); </script> </body> </html>
